ambiguities.text: Errors must conform to the ProviderRpcError shape 'whenever possible'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all provider-originated errors should conform, but underlying transport errors (network failures) may not have standard codes.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define timeout behavior for requests
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementation-defined timeout behavior. DApps should implement their own timeout handling.

ambiguities.text: The distinction between error 4900 (Disconnected) and 4901 (Chain Disconnected) is not fully clear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 4900 means complete provider failure, while 4901 means provider works but specific chain unavailable.

implicit_assumptions.description: The user implicitly trusts the Ethereum Provider because it was injected by their chosen wallet extension
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious provider could intercept requests, modify transactions, or steal private keys

implicit_assumptions.description: The JavaScript runtime provides adequate isolation between DApp code and provider internals
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DApps could potentially access provider private data or modify provider behavior

implicit_assumptions.description: Only one provider object is injected, or the user has chosen which to use
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Provider conflicts could cause unexpected behavior or security issues when multiple wallets installed
